Subject: Draft two-day rotation for Backend PM candidate — Alexis Moreno

Hi all,

I sketched a two-day virtual loop for Alexis (Backend PM) that splits technical deep-dives and product/strategy conversations across Day 1 and Day 2. Goal: keep each slot to 50 min with 20–30 min debrief windows between panels for the hiring panelists. Draft attached (two-day-rotation-draft.ics) + candidate prep (candidate_prep-agenda.pdf).

Key asks:
- Can you confirm which sessions you can own? I proposed: Mina — System design / infra; Stephanie — Product & metrics; Laura — Team fit / collaboration.
- Is 50 min + 20 min debrief workable or should we shorten to 40/20 to reduce candidate fatigue?
- Any conflicts Oct 28–29 (we're aiming for those dates)?

Plan summary (draft):
Day 1 (AM): Intro + product / PM deep-dive (50)
Day 1 (PM): System design deep-dive (50)
Day 2 (AM): Cross-functional / collaboration + leadership (50)
Day 2 (PM): Exec alignment + final Qs (50)

I'll hold off on sending to Alexis until we lock owners/times.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looks good. A few items:
- I can take the System design slot but would swap Day 1 PM -> Day 2 AM if we want the deep dive after the candidate has seen the product context. That gives the candidate a bit more context before design.
- Recommend 40 min interviews + 15 min debrief, then 30 min lunch block. Back-to-back 50s will exhaust candidate.
- We should assign a single debrief owner for day-end score consolidation. I volunteer to own Day 1 consolidation if that helps.

Attached: debrief-rubric-template.xlsx with suggested rubric fields.
